description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData class, which implements the ReportData interface to generate and normalize report data related to employee leave entitlements and usage. It interacts with leave entitlement and employee services, formats data for reporting, and provides report metadata.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for generating employee leave entitlement and usage report data, including formatting and metadata.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates an array of leave entitlement and usage data for a specific employee, formatted for reporting, including URLs for detailed views.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, including total leave types count and employee information.
